version: 0.1.0
kind: workspace-folder
metadata:
  name: system.sessions
  description: Ephemeral session records for active workspace runs and resumable interactions.
spec:
  path: .workspace/system.sessions
  lifecycle: volatile
  tracking: ignored
  volatility: high
  naming:
    reserved_files:
      - _root.yaml
      - "*.session.yaml"
    versioning: semver
